svg.title: Fleet storage atlas: devices, content and recovery routes
svg.desc: Fi desktop and its secondary SSD, Li laptop, Si server with storage and parity, Google Drive and Photos, Cloudflare, Git and Bitwarden. Six lanes distinguish synchronization, snapshots, copies, archives, parity and deployment. Cloudflare backups run weekly to Fi; Google Drive archives and native documents are backed up daily to Si. Immich evaluation is pending.

g.text: The fleet. The files. The recovery paths.
Current backup configuration • locations and relationships • schedules in HKT
CLOUDFLARE / WEEKLY RESTIC BACKUP TO FI SECONDARY DISK
DNS + KV exports and R2 objects · Sunday 03:00 HKT · 1 weekly + 1 monthly snapshot
Grouped cards indicate ownership / containment, not a copy
Main disk: work + independent Si app copy
Provider grouping • not a backup destination
Each lane is a separate scope • repeated device IDs are intentional
Client repos • daily to annual bands
SQLite / DB exports + app state + configs + public/library
Selected config / state / secrets; R2 also holds public assets
Configured parity scope only; no version history
Drive archives and native docs are backed up to Si
Daily encrypted Restic backup on Si
Content tags can overlap • archive = inactive material • backup = recovery copy
BLUE sync / Git GREEN versioned recovery PURPLE parity TEAL hosting / deployment AMBER pending / unconfirmed
Coverage limits: client repos have no Fi copy; Google Photos has no independent copy; preserve Ephemera’s final image.
